settings.requests.showReqHint: Any number of seasons counts as one
settings.requests.musicReqHint: An artist or album counts as one
settings.requests.title: Request rules
settings.requests.defaultsA: Defaults for everyone; set one person's own limits on the
settings.requests.defaultsB: page. 0 means no limit. Approvers have none. Taken-back and turned-down requests don't count, nor does joining someone else's.
settings.requests.musicFolderHint: Only requested albums are kept up to date
settings.requests.searchHint: Movies search at once; shows at the next feed check
settings.requests.plexDesc: Titles on your Plex watchlist become requests
settings.requests.plexOnHint: Each person turns it on in My account. Their Limits apply.
settings.requests.plexEveryone: Turn on for everyone who signs in with Plex
settings.requests.plexEveryoneHint: Anyone can turn it off for themselves in My account.
settings.requests.plexFriendsHint: Friends you imported from Plex. Their watchlists are read through your Plex link, and each friend's Limits apply.
settings.requests.plexFriendsNoLink: Link Plex in Settings › Sign-in first.
settings.requests.plexFriendsNone: No one imported from Plex yet.
settings.requests.fourKDesc: Where approved 4K requests go and how they are picked
settings.requests.choicesDesc: The Quality buttons on request sheets, in this order. Rename or hide them here; Kids get the first one shown.
settings.requests.choiceNotReady: Offered once a 4K quality is set up above
settings.requests.autoApproveNote: Off = their requests wait for you. Plex watchlist titles follow the same switch.
settings.requests.pickMany: Let people pick more than one
settings.requests.pickManyHint: Someone can ask for Standard and 4K together. Only qualities kept as their own copy can be added.
settings.requests.streamingDesc: Pick the services you have. HolyArrs can skip downloads already on them.
settings.requests.streamingNone: No streaming services are listed for this country.
settings.requests.streamingSkip: Skip if it's on my services
settings.requests.streamingSkipHint: A movie or show request on one of your services is turned down with a note saying where it streams. Approve it again to download it anyway.
settings.requests.cleanupDesc: Finds movies and shows with files that stream on your services. Nothing is removed until you confirm each one.
settings.requests.cleanupNothing: None of your {total} titles with files are on your services.
settings.requests.cleanupFailed: Could not check {n}; try again later.
